examples.text: That is not to say that he became a doddery old man — far from it. He was just a bit thoughtful at times, and I would catch him looking at me pensively...
The old boy's so doddery now he can hardly finish the course at all. I timed him today. It took him seventy-five seconds...

glosses: mentally or physically infirm due to old age; senile

examples.text: You great fat, blasted, blear-eyed, blundering, thundering, brainless, God-forsaken, doddering, damned fool!
Treat the doddering old fool with sympathy.
She treats him not as a doddering old fool but as a man hampered in his movements by injury.

glosses: present participle and gerund of dodder
